annotations.title: Add records to a sheet table

description: Adds records, each a map of field name → value. Choices by option name (a new name becomes a new option); dates as YYYY-MM-DD; people by user id; checkboxes true/false. Every problem is reported at once and nothing is written until all records are valid.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

table.description: The table tab's name or id.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this.
